rounds.text: Gogia Capital Growth Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational turnaround that is not yet reflected in its depressed valuation. The most compelling evidence of this shift is the dramatic improvement in quarterly operating margins, which surged to 11% in June 2026 from a negative 152% in the year-ago quarter [E27]. This operational recovery is supported by a massive 181% growth in trailing twelve-month sales [E16] and recent screen data highlighting year-over-year sales and net profit growth of 338% and 425% respectively [E51, E53]. Furthermore, the company has successfully strengthened its balance sheet, maintaining a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.07x [E34] and generating positive free cash flow of Rs 0.33 Cr as of March 2026 [E32]. The business has also made tangible progress in working capital management, with debtor days improving significantly from 579 to 167 days [E43]. Conceded: [E3], [E7], [E8], [E9], [E11], [E12], [E17], [E28], [E37], [E44], [E45], [E46], [E47], [E48], [E49]. While historical metrics remain poor, the current evidence suggests that the company’s recent performance trajectory is fundamentally decoupling from its past [E56].
